_comment: EXAMPLE per-project gate configuration for a NON-SEM-IA consumer project (here: a mobile app). ADR-013. To adopt SEM-IA in your project: copy this file to .claude/role-scope.json and edit the role arrays to your product roots. The UNION of all arrays = the gate's protected artifact space (no substrate file in those roots may be created/modified without a governing node in graph/ and the right active role); each array = that role's jurisdiction. The imported SEM-IA framework (.claude/**, _obsidian/templates/) is INTENTIONALLY ABSENT below -> it is ungated (it is the tool you imported, not the product you build); add a maintainer-role glob only if you deliberately want framework edits gated too. The gate's hardcoded always-ignore guard (graph/**, sessions/**, .claude/.active-role, CLAUDE.local.md, .git/**, .obsidian/**, /tmp, out-of-repo) always wins regardless of this file. Globs: '**' any depth, '*' one segment.
